Do NOT repeat its standard lancet-window/pointed-arch blueprint. We need a visibly different construction and negative-space silhouette at thumbnail size, not different cracks or window decorations. Strict FLAT FRONT elevation for a 2D side-scroller, no perspective/side walls. Entire object visible, truly TRANSPARENT background and internal holes. Small masonry shoulder blocks only. NO windows, NO solid facade, NO pointed arches, NO rooftop. Clearly a skeletal industrial cathedral support, not a conventional tower wall. Flat full-width top/bottom joints.
